feeds.title: Business Green
feeds.description: BusinessGreen provides companies with information on how to plan and undertake successful green initiatives that both cut costs and enhance the brand values of their organisations. The UK's leading source of information for the green economy, delivering the latest news and in-depth analysis on green business and environmental issues.

feeds.title: Andrew Winston Blog
feeds.description: Andrew Winston, author The Big Pivot, co-author of Green to Gold, strategist...commentary on the world's mega trends and how companies can navigate them.

feeds.title: Green Buoy Consulting Blog
feeds.description: Sustainability Consulting and Information for Small & Early Stage Businesses. Get tips to incorporate sustainability into your early stage or small business, without having to hire a sustainability consultant.

feeds.title: GreenMoney
feeds.description: GreenMoney is one of the world's leading sustainable business and impact investing media brands with its monthly eJournal and website focused on publishing innovative solutions and responsible leadership. The GreenMoney Journal was launched in 1992 by Cliff Feigenbaum, that was followed by the greenmoney.com website in 1995.

feeds.title: Eco-Business
feeds.description: Eco-Business is an independent media and business intelligence company that publish high-quality, trusted news, and views in multimedia formats on business and policy developments around the world with a sustainability and ESG-focused lens. Our platform features more than a decade-long archive of information globally.

feeds.title: Green Business Journal
feeds.description: The Green Business Journal is an unbiased digital publication written to highlight the latest and biggest green business and environmental news from across the UK; aiming to support, inspire and generate collaboration for a sustainable future.

feeds.title: Greener Ideal » Business
feeds.description: Greener Ideal helps you live in more sustainable ways with green living tips, commentary on the latest environmental news, green product reviews, healthy recipes, and more. Stay up to date with our guide for businesses for tips and advice to make your business sustainable, how to go green and more!

feeds.title: California Green Business Network Blog
feeds.description: The California Green Business Program leads the state and nation in working with small to medium-sized businesses to grow a vibrant and healthy green economy. Led by a coalition of cities and counties, they contribute to more livable communities with healthier environments, while also conserving resources and saving money. Get into their blog and learn more about green business, tips, the latest news, and more.

feeds.title: Eco-Office Gals Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer Smith is the author of Eco-Office Gals. After a decade of unloved jobs, Jennifer still couldn't figure out what she wanted to do when she grew up. Love of design, learning and teaching, and the frustration of wasted paper started the steady growth of what is today Eco-Office Gals. Eco-Office Gals strives to build businesses green and paperless. Follow this blog and get ideas for businesses interested in making a lighter Environmental Impact.

feeds.title: Clear Strategy
feeds.description: Read the Clear Strategy Company Blog to get the latest insights on everything ESG and sustainable business. From articles focusing on Rising Oil and gas investments to Global changing ESG efforts, get a clear understanding of the Sustainability play. Clear Strategy offers assessment, training, and advisory services to companies to help them achieve ESG goals.

feeds.title: Green America Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest news, information, tips, tools, and the consumer base to help you thrive in today's competitive green marketplace. Green America's Green Business Network is the first & most diverse network of socially and environmentally responsible businesses in the country.

feeds.title: Green and Grumpy
feeds.description: Green and Grumpy is a blog that tackles sustainable living with a sense of humor because going green can often be difficult, frustrating and confusing. Our readers are everyday, real, imperfect people striving to do the best they can to live a more sustainable lifestyle.

feeds.title: Terra Infirma Blog
feeds.description: Terra Infirma Ltd are UK based environment and sustainability consultants with an excellent track record in bringing environmental and economic benefits to our clients.

feeds.title: Green Office Blog
feeds.description: We follow a process that drives continuous improvement by assessing, analyzing, reporting, actioning and measuring everything we do with the aim to achieve maximized cost, print and waste reductions within our clients' business environments. The blog features the latest news and updates on our projects, sustainability tips and advice and more!

feeds.title: Sustainability = Smart Business
feeds.description: I'm Tobias Webb, founder of Innovation Forum and Sustainable Wine. I write on this blog, with others, about areas of interest to me in supply chains, circular economy and sustainability in general. I hope you find it useful. I've worked in sustainability for about 20 years, and work with large companies, NGOs and governments all over the world.

feeds.title: cooleeme
feeds.description: Shower Balls by Cooleeme are the solution for the challenges with travel essentials. Unique single-use size tablets make packing toiletries for travelling easier than ever without compromising performance, quality, and hygiene. They are made with sustainability in mind from manufacturing to disposal stages. Check out the blog for more eco-friendly travel practices, tips to make your tourist businesses sustainable for environment and more!

feeds.title: Greener Jc Blog
feeds.description: Greener JC is committed to supporting a more sustainable future in Jersey City. The organization's actions include but are not limited to, promoting waste and energy reduction through community outreach and educational actions, supporting sustainable development efforts, and facilitating partnerships to help the community be resilient in the face of global climate change. Check out the green businesses in the Jersey City with the blog.

feeds.title: Great Green Content Blog
feeds.description: Great Green Content provides quality copywriting and content marketing services to sustainable businesses.

feeds.title: Trellis Group
feeds.description: Trellis Group empowers sustainability professionals to tackle the climate crisis through our industry-leading events, media and peer network.

feeds.title: The Green Market Oracle
feeds.description: Read about a comprehensive source of news and information on climate change, sustainable development and green economy. The convergence of sustainable capitalism and the global environment.

feeds.title: Tree Hugger
feeds.description: Green design & living news covering technology, architecture, transportation and more. Featuring sustainable living commentary, features and solutions. Follow this site to find everything you need to know about living a healthy and eco-friendly life, with an emphasis on nature, science and sustainable design.

feeds.title: The Dosage
feeds.description: News and commentary from the leading voices in sustainable IT.

feeds.title: EnvironBuzz
feeds.description: Covers perspectives and news on sustainability (environmental, social and economic) from a global perspective. EnvironBuzz Mag is an online magazine owned by EnvironFocus. We also use this platform to recognize/showcase clients and other organizations, impacting our ecosystem positively.

feeds.title: We Buy It Green
feeds.description: We provide you the eco and environmentally-friendly products that you can buy to support prevent plastic pollution and also help to change the world. Check out the blog for more information on green business, sustainable products, manufacturing and more!
